authority: User-approved Government Design Talk; Codex records decisions only. Current Spec references this content; reading Markdown is not independent authority.

focus: 专业多样化转化为当前政策容量
政策机动性与整体治理效能
philosophy.lv2_note: 轻量设计可承担进入III／IV的机会成本，不补第二能力。

basic_support.G: current Government Tier, not building Tier or Shared D
basic_support.eligible_building_catalog: TECHNICAL_INVESTIGATION_REQUIRED; use Government Plaza / government-building facts, no compatibility catalog in this revision
basic_support.intent: 政体成熟带来更稳定、更高规格的供给、组织与建设保障。

policy_cost.intent: 常设官僚体系降低行政摩擦。

institution_study.qualification: already owns one Government Plaza building in the corresponding building Tier
institution_study.targets: other buildings of that same Tier, each studied separately
institution_study.cost_semantics: 完整生产回合的制度时间／机会成本；不是重新施工，不是固定Production cost，不可被高Production压缩
institution_study.game_speed: scale normally; exact multiplier and integer rounding remain TECHNICAL / DESIGN DETAIL REQUIRED
institution_study.one_shot_rewards: must not duplicate; Governor Title is an example requiring separate audit
institution_study.physical_building_completion: not required by Design; no automatic free completion of mutually exclusive buildings
institution_study.history: completed learning is city historical / institutional accumulation; temporary Governor or ACTIVE loss must not erase it
institution_study.intent: 研究、论证、吸收并制度化其它治理路线。

legacy_selection.eligible_choice: one Legacy Effect of another government at current Government Tier or below
legacy_selection.government_change: selected Legacy that becomes current government self-Legacy or exceeds current Tier must not apply illegally or duplicate
legacy_selection.configuration_retention_or_pause: TBD; no choice between retaining-and-pausing or deleting in this handoff
legacy_selection.asset_kind: current institutional configuration, not permanent historical achievement
legacy_selection.intent: 比较、取鉴其它治理制度并吸收一种经验。

diversity_slots.N: count of distinct non-Government specialization types currently ACTIVE IV
diversity_slots.loss: corresponding qualifying type disappears -> remove its slot; restoration recomputes
balance_observations: unneeded profession leveling solely for slots
diversity_slots.intent: 当前真正成熟并运作的专业分工提高国家政策承载容量。

first_policy_free.scope: each turn first player-initiated complete policy configuration is free
first_policy_free.native_free_opportunities: Civic completion, Government change and other native rules preserved
first_policy_free.balance_observation: only investigate specific HD policies with high immediate realization value later; no generic anti-micro restriction
first_policy_free.intent: 成熟国家机器按时势快速调整政策。

governance_yields.yield_set: All Yields as stated; exact included yield set is DESIGN_DETAIL_REQUIRED, do not silently assume six / Tourism / GPP
governance_yields.intent: 更成熟政体的组织效率；背景型收益，不增加独立系统。

institution_learning.completed_results: city historical / institutional accumulation direction accepted; do not erase for temporary Governor / ACTIVE loss
institution_learning.current_effect_activation: not fully specified beyond normal Shared ACTIVE ability gates
institution_learning.identity_exit_owner_change_recapture: TBD; do not borrow other profession inheritance
institution_learning.unfinished_project_interruption_and_save: TBD; no automatic Dialogue contract adoption

selected_legacy.invalid_current_government_effect: must not apply; exact config retention not selected

lifecycle.wildcard_slots: current derived state only, recompute from current distinct ACTIVE IV types

scope.player_carrier: current plan dedicated blank civilization only, explicit opt-in; no default original/Mod Civ and Leader bonus compatibility obligation
scope.current_runtime_scope: single-player local human only; no AI or multiplayer implementation
scope.future_reuse: not permanently forbidden; separately authorized future scope, no support guarantee
scope.localization: Chinese idiomatic names permitted; future functional English need not translate word-for-word; no English names frozen here

cross_profession_refs.canal: existing CAN-001 Government adjacency Food direction unchanged
cross_profession_refs.state_visit: existing DIP-MISSION-014 future framework unchanged; not a Diplomatic redesign

policy_gold_discount.meaning: significant reduction of player-initiated policy Gold cost; no -50%/-75% chosen

governance_k_pp_per_tier.alternative: 2 percentage points per Tier may be explored later, not adopted here

open_details.detail: 内政司机构名与政制择用项目名；不扩命名讨论。
政令通达折扣、治理效能k、额外Wildcard边际价值和强升IV倾向。
制度学习Identity退出、易主、夺回、当前效力、未完成多回合项目中断／保存；Legacy配置保存／暂停／身份退出／易主及失格后的保留表现。
合格市政建筑、长期效果承载与互斥、一次性奖励分离；不展开全兼容表。
完整多回合制度项目、游戏速度缩放／整数回合；Legacy效果目录与无槽直接承载。
动态槽位、完整政策配置与原生免费机会区分、All Yields精确范围与全国百分比承载。
多个市政来源并存时的全国能力组合、每回合首次主动配置的免费机会与原生免费机会计数关系、未声明Government Tier值；不自行添加cap／公式。
少数具体HD即时政策套利；不因此在当前规则添加cooldown。

supersession.old: automatic free completion of other two same-Tier Government buildings
supersession.replacement: institution_study; separately earned continuous effects, no repeated one-shots

supersession.old: permanent Governor Title per Potential level (up to four)

supersession.replacement: diversity_slots; distinct current non-Government ACTIVE IV types

supersession.old: weak Loyalty Network and its pending value
supersession.replacement: OBSOLETE; no added independent Government Network Ability

supersession.old_rule: ELIG-001/002/006, ID-001, COMPAT-001 previous carrier scope
supersession.old: current carrier could other Civ; default Civ/Leader coexistence and prohibition of blank-only scope
supersession.replacement: current dedicated blank civilization; future reuse only separately authorized

implementation_gate: Design acceptance only, no Government implementation authorization or native evidence; current B163 Culture probe remains pending.
